...So, anyway.{p}
rows.01:aaa8:
We met up at the old building in the middle of the night.
Do you know what the school's like in the middle of the night?
You'd think it's dark.
Actually, it's surprisingly bright.
Early in the night, it's dark. Scary dark.
But in the dead of night, the sky goes pale, and the moonlight is actually pretty beautiful.
I was kind of excited.
I was thinking I'd brag to the guys in my class about this later.{p}
rows.01:abe4:
But get this.
The moment we stepped into the old building, the air completely changed.
...There's something here.
That's how it felt.
rows.01:ac5c: We hurried to that mirror, half running.{p}
rows.01:aca8:
And then we waited for the time to come.
With the mirror Yoshioka brought facing the mirror on the landing.
"What the hell is that? Looks like something a woman would use."
I said.
I felt uneasy if I wasn't talking about something.
I had a feeling something truly terrifying might actually happen.
What Yoshioka had brought was a dingy old round makeup mirror.
Apparently it was from the bathroom at his house.
He said it was the mirror he used a lot, like after a bath.
And while we were talking, three o'clock, thirty-three minutes, thirty-three seconds...
The moment came.{p}So what do you think happened?
